Read the complete admission Owner and every product call site. Fixed shapes are private detached snapshots with typed properties and Owner serialization. Selection, ownership, history digest, complete recipient Run/Assistant witnesses, clone provenance and missing/null rejection have a single validator; no dictionary compatibility interface remains. Dynamic storage/Engine consumers use the existing transaction and validated bindings; the public stored schema and error text are unchanged. JSON syntax ownership review: validator calls now target JsonObject. The validator body is AST-identical after expanding its canonical declarations; each consumer AST is identical after normalizing only that call/import, and every original import scope is preserved, including the isolated worker. Record-specific mandatory fields, policy, identity, version, CAS, effects and permission validation are unchanged. ProjectConfig retains a direct public delegate, never a second validator.

reason: Reviewed all Schema generation, field declarations, runtime observations, normalization and argument constraint parsing/narrowing. Fixed policy views use typed attributes; only this Owner interprets its wire rules, dynamic Tool/argument maps and selected opaque parameter values. Standard Schema vocabulary is shared. Full Schema and errors/omission match the prior implementation across 446 cases. Approval keeps order/IDs/risk checks; Tool policy/Retry readers, context/Run/output consumers and binding serializer use declared fields. Explicit defaults are observations, never materialized settings. No legacy ToolPolicy type or execution path is restored. Agent resource/profile review: added canonical capability identity or validated detached AgentProfile/Policy/ResourceSelection projection, retaining exact original Schema/Reader/revision and stored omission/null/explicit values. Prompt/Skill capability declarations now originate in their pure record Owner and Component names refer to it. ToolPolicyValues declares the same None unrestricted set and shares only the existing subset predicate with preflight and child scope creation. Old/new definition wire/revision, selection/binding/capabilities, input/output Schema and scope limits match; all earlier file contracts and incomplete consumer tracking remain.

reason: Read complete output/delta/reference and Completion receipt/container/result implementation. CompletionResult now also owns partial/final normalized observations using its declared slot names. Original field read/merge/reasoning order, deep copies, received-but-undrained unknown usage and drained-before-finish evidence are preserved across 45 old/new decoder traces. Stored fields and record validation remain identical.

reason: Read complete declared observation envelope and typed payload access/writes. The three metadata fields have one Owner; EngineOutput/Diagnostic/OperationProgress remain the payload Readers. Run final output rejects present null while optional Step output/progress/diagnostic retain established null absence; these are distinct public projections, not alternate schemas or compatibility Readers. Raw diagnostic snapshot preserves original absent versus explicit null behavior. Writers serialize only the supplied value and do no file I/O, permission inference or missing-record repair. Protected metadata uses the same declarations, and callers keep existing watch/transaction/ACK ordering.

reason: Read all model invocation values, finite JSON/object/nested usage validators, exact current-record Reader, normalized enums, per-format serializers and runtime copy. Fields derive from owning slots instead of implementation strings; ModelRecord declares shared version field/versioned selection but each format keeps its separate VERSION. Writer retains exact field order, explicit null/false/zero, typed nested content/calls/results and opaque signed state. Strict role/result pairing, no interleaving/duplicate exchanges, nonnegative exact counts, ranking/embedding validation and no multimodal text destruction remain. Runtime parameters preserve injected client/callback identity while mutable containers detach, and serialization rejects runtime handles. These values cannot authorize tools/retries or release reservations; actual Adapter/Loop/RAG/processing/Hub consumers are tested.
